text:
Hi Carmen, sharing here what happened to us that was similar : I was asked to provide the same celibate before marriage document when we registered our wedding here… I was living in Israel for 2 years with a B1 visa before we got married so they had all these documents from the time of the initial application. 
I had left the country a few times though and when we argued about not needing this celibacy doc with the clerk from MH she answered that since I had left the country a few times, they had no way of knowing that I didn’t marry someone else while I was out of Israel … I understand that you didn’t leave so not sure why they are asking you for this… I was not asked for new criminal records. 

I was able to ask my local townhall in France that had married us for this paper they wanted that is not a standard document in France, I hope you will find it also 🙏 of course everything needed to be appostiled and translated so it took another 2 months to get these missing documents and file our marriage in Israel… 
Good luck, they don’t make it easy on us but having the A5 visa makes life a little smoother here 🫶
